content.text:
good morning — mira has her 18-month vaccines coming up in about two weeks, so now's a good time to ring the pediatric office and get that on the calendar if it isn't already. at this stage she may also start stringing two words together ("more milk," "bye dada"), so it's a fun thing to listen for in the coming weeks without any pressure.

on the local front, there's a drop-in parent-and-tot swim at the community pool this saturday — a nice low-key outing if the summer heat calls for it.
